_doc: Khuôn Reels (docs/specs/social-reels-templates.md): Ama/Carlos đọc mẫu tiếng Anh ≤150 wpm, chừa lặng cho người xem đọc theo (repeat), IPA lấy từ kho từ lúc dựng, chữ bản địa viết tay (native-qa).

mistake.en: Adding e before s, saying h silently, and saying v like b

items.native: No añadas una e al principio
items.gloss_en: Do not add an e at the start.

items.native: La h se pronuncia: es un soplo suave
items.gloss_en: The h is pronounced, it is a soft breath.

items.native: La v toca el labio con los dientes
items.gloss_en: The v touches your lip with your teeth.

segments.text: Four words many learners say wrong. Listen, then repeat after me.

native.hook: 4 palabras que se suelen decir mal
native.caption: ¿Dices “eschool” en vez de “school”? Fíjate también en la h de “house”, en la v de “very” y en la s muda de “island”. Escucha a Carlos y repite tú en la pausa. Practica la pronunciación en la app Lexkite.

en.caption: Do you say “eschool” instead of “school”? Also watch the h in “house”, the v in “very” and the silent s in “island”. Listen to Carlos and repeat in the pause. Practice pronunciation in the Lexkite app.
